steps.body: The ×9 facts sit one group below the ×10 facts: 9 × 7 is 70 minus 7.
steps.narration: The ×9 facts sit one group below the ×10 facts: 9 × 7 is 70 minus 7.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 9 rows of 7.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 63 squares, but not as 9 rows of 7. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.successFeedback: 9 rows of 7 is 63 — one row short of 70.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 63 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 63 squares. The array should stop at 9 rows of 7.

predict.reveal: One fewer GROUP means 7 fewer, not 1 fewer: 70 − 7 = 63.
